historical_programs.sql_template: WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC
